boundary.role: the four-column table (good, lazy, nice, chain) indexed by level

consumers_of_level_outside_the_boundary.what: if (level > 2 && (last_lit & 0xfff) == 0) -- an early block-flush heuristic active only above level 2; OUTSIDE deflate.c entirely
FAST / SLOW header flag bytes (inside the boundary; affect one header byte, never the compressed stream)

mechanism_claim.functional_claim: The -1..-9 level selects four search thresholds from a static table; those thresholds, plus exactly two level-keyed switches outside the table (the greedy/lazy path switch at deflate.c:667 and the block-flush heuristic at trees.c:987), account for ALL level-dependent variation in compressed size and time. No other code path reads the level.
mechanism_claim.claimed_outputs: max_lazy_match, good_match, nice_match, max_chain_length (the table); the fast/lazy branch; the flush heuristic gate
mechanism_claim.claimed_internal_dependency: longest_match reads chain/good/nice each call; deflate() reads max_lazy per byte; deflate_fast ignores lazy; the trees.c gate fires per 4096 literals
mechanism_claim.known_uncertainty: whether the trees.c:987 heuristic changes SIZE measurably on a ~1 MB source corpus (it changes block boundaries; effect may be below 0.1%); whether timing on a small corpus is stable enough to see chain-length effects below level 6

interventions.intervention_operation: no code change; run levels 1..9 on CORPUS-A
interventions.band_basis: prior experience of gzip on source text: -1 ~0.30-0.36, -9 ~0.26-0.30; deliberately wide
interventions.prediction_rationale: chain 4 -> 4096, lazy 4 -> 258, nice 8 -> 258 across the table; more search finds longer matches; the step at 3->4 (deflate_fast -> lazy) is allowed to be NON_MONOTONIC in ratio because level 4 has a SHORTER chain (16) than level 3 (32)

secondary.band_basis: chain length 4 vs 4096 bounds the work per position; the corpus is small so the band is wide

interventions.intervention_operation: edit deflate.c:225-245 so rows 2..9 equal row 1 ({4, 4, 8, 4}); rebuild; run levels 1..9 on CORPUS-A
interventions.measured_observable: spread of ratio within {1,2}, within {3}, within {4..9}; and the steps 2->3 and 3->4
interventions.units: max absolute ratio difference WITHIN each group {1,2}, {4..9}
interventions.band_basis: with identical thresholds the only remaining level dependence is the two switches outside the table; within a group neither switch changes
interventions.prediction_rationale: isolates the table: if within-group spread exceeds the band, something else reads the level (CUT_KILL)

secondary.observable: step 3->4 (fast -> lazy at row-1 thresholds) and step 2->3 (trees.c flush gate)
secondary.band_basis: lazy matching with max_lazy 4 barely defers; the flush heuristic moves block boundaries only; both effects are expected small and of unknown sign; a step above 0.02 is a surprise to record, not a kill

interventions.intervention_operation: I1 plus: force deflate.c:667 to always take the lazy path (compr_level <= 3 -> 0) and force trees.c:987 gate to true for all levels (level > 2 -> 1); rebuild; run levels 1..9
interventions.measured_observable: max absolute ratio difference across ALL nine levels; max relative time difference across levels
interventions.units: absolute ratio difference (ratio); time within [0.8, 1.25] relative (secondary)
interventions.band_basis: the mechanism claim says these three sites exhaust level dependence; 0.002 is the header-byte and block-boundary noise floor guessed generously
interventions.prediction_rationale: THE decisive intervention for the claim: nine identical outputs (modulo the header flag byte) or the claim is false

interventions.intervention_operation: unmodified table except row 6 max_chain 128 -> 4096; rebuild; run level 6 only
interventions.units: absolute ratio (ratio decreases or stays); time ratio secondary [1.0, 10.0]
interventions.band_basis: chain length alone buys little once nice_match (128) stops the search early; time grows with the chain walk
interventions.prediction_rationale: separates the four columns: chain length is the cost knob, nice_match the ratio ceiling; if ratio improves by more than 0.01, nice is not binding as the cut assumes

cheat.construction: CORPUS-B (CORPUS-A already compressed at level 9 by the unmodified fossil) run through levels 1..9 of every build (baseline, I1, I2, I3)
cheat.expected_result: ratio >= 0.99 at every level in every build; max absolute ratio difference across levels <= 0.002
cheat.failure_interpretation: if any level or build 'gains' on incompressible input, the measurement is reading something other than compression (a size accounting error, a header difference, a wrong file); every other row of this packet is then INDETERMINATE

positive.construction: baseline build, CORPUS-A, level 1 vs level 9, >= 5 timed runs each
positive.expected_result: ratio(1) - ratio(9) >= 0.01 AND time(9) > time(1) in every run pair
positive.failure_interpretation: if the instrument cannot see the difference between the extreme rows on the baseline, it cannot adjudicate I1-I3; the packet is INDETERMINATE, not falsified

cut_kill.observation: I2-FLATTEN-PLUS-SWITCHES leaves a level-dependent ratio difference > 0.002 or a time difference outside [0.8, 1.25] on CORPUS-A, with both controls passing
cut_kill.consequence: a fourth consumer of the level exists outside the three named sites; the boundary of four_threshold_table_indexed_by_level and the mechanism claim are wrong; a NEW CUT of gzip-1.2.4-1993 is required (this packet stays immutable; the new cut names the site found)

indeterminate.observation: any of: C-CHEAT-PRECOMPRESSED fails; C-POS-LEVEL-EXTREMES fails; the fossil does not build in the fossil world; timing min-of-5 spread exceeds 25% at any level (underpowered); a surrogate rather than the fossil binary was measured without a divergence ledger showing identical outputs on CORPUS-A
indeterminate.consequence: no reading of I1-I3 is made; the packet is returned PREDICTION_INDETERMINATE with the failing item named; it is neither support nor rejection of the cut
